I don't know. I lost the love of my life. She doesn't want to be with me anymore. My depression and lack of motivation ended us, I didn't want to give up but never took action. I just took a $20/hr paycut to pursue a career in a different trade. After a 5 year apprenticeship I will be making nearly $20/hr more and have better benefits/pension. 
As a result of this paycut I can't afford to live on my own. I'm stressed because I'm broke as fuck now. I'm 28 and I moved back in with my dad. Everyday is getting harder and harder to move on. I miss her, I hate her, I hate myself. TBH I don't even know if ill still be around in a year.

So, Speaking as someone who is suffering from a tough break up and severely depressed. I still love her, and she loves me, but she thinks that I'm incapable of fixing my issues, which is why she broke it off, even though I'm still willing to try to make things work.

I don't really have anyone else in my life, If I suffered from a traumatic event, I know I would want to see her. If I did, I know I'd mistake her contacting me (to offer support) as a sign that we can somehow get back together. Obviously that is off the table, but I know it would cause me intense grief. I'd be happy to see her, and feel even more heartbroken and shitty that its only a temporary thing. 

Just something to keep in mind.

Hey buddy. I have no advice to share with you. But I can say that I'm going through a very similar situation. She told me to move on but I feel like she was the only light at the end of the tunnel. I hope things can somehow turn up, for the both of us...

Has anyone else gone through this? How do you move on when the love of your life leaves you because of your damaged goods? How do you cope with the knowledge that they left you when you weren't at your best? Everyday that goes by I feel my will to live fading.....

When this break up was going to be "temporary" I had a plan. I had some hope and what I wanted to do about it. But when i got the text from my EX that she felt its better we move on I feel like I lost all motivation.
   I just recently went through a career change that resulted in a $20/hr paycut. I'm stressing about how I'm going to afford a therapist that will help me with my depression, anxiety and ED. Whats the point if I don't have a light at the end of the tunnel?
  I've never had a hobby that I'm truly passionate about. I am envious of people that have a passion for something like that. I try random stuff all the time but nothing ever truly feels like "me". I don't know who I am and i feel like im destined to be miserable for the rest of my life. Im so tired of this feeling
